services.name: Moore Farms Botanical Garden
services.desc: (MFBG) is young, but already recognized as a horticultural jewel of the Southeast. Opened in 2002, the garden is now over 900 acres, including a 65 acre gardened core dedicated to the horticultural possibilities of the south. Education and research, agriculture and natural land management round out the benefits provided the visiting public. MFBG is wildly beautiful, creative and soulful. We seek to inspire, inform and delight. Discover plants, and our interaction with them. The garden is a collection of exuberant plant displays, romantic meadows and vistas of grey-green pines. services.name: Riverrat’s Kayak and Canoe Rentals
services.desc: Paddle amongst the Bald Cypress of the beautiful Lynches River with RiverRat’s Kayak and Canoe Rentals. Paddlers can enjoy the scenery with friends and family, or have a guided tour. RiverRat’s offers a great outdoor activity for hands-on educational experiences, team building and church groups, all geared towards disconnecting from the daily hustle and bustle. Lynches River is about 173 miles long and has more than 110 miles of designated scenic river. The section starting at Lee State Park and ending at Great Pee Dee River has been designated as the longest wild and scenic river in South Carolina.
